items.q: And he also lived in this development. I got to know him then.

ctx.x: Did you ever get to know Paul Robeson at all on all those dates you played with him or --

Well, I didn't get to know him then, because I couldn't get to him for the people. But in later years he moved into my -- I lived in a -- let's see, how do I say it, the metropolitan development. It's like apartments -- it's called the Riverton in New York, 135th and Madison. And he also lived in this development. I got to know him then. Beautiful man, just a marvelous, marvelous human being. And I realized that this man sacrificed his whole career for --
